title: Review the piece
why: Nothing that judges runs at low effort, and this piece's proof is runs against controls: the two red messages, the compare of main against the branch, the floor, the idle control and a deliberate break to the buttons script. Seven haiku builds make the read for what they left half-done the review's real work, so Opus medium. It writes the answer and the evidence into the PR and adds the decisions to the design's ledgers.
